targets.outcome_quote: We started this project with the assumption that we would replicate the temporal framing effect and extend the literature by investigating the drivers of this effect. However, upon failing to replicate the effect, our program of research pivoted to instead assess the possible reasons for this non-replication in a large-scale preregistered second study.
